name: word
description: Read, edit and create Word .docx files - including Word tracked changes, native styles and filling out templates.

docs_dir.title: Documents folder
docs_dir.description: Folder of .docx files the server may open and save, searched recursively. REQUIRED - the server refuses to start without it. Defaults to the Word folder of the Eva working tree; copy the repo's eva\ folder to C:\Eva and it exists.

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: Where msword_create writes NEW documents, kept separate from the documents folder so generated files never mix with your source library. Enter 'off' to write new documents into the documents folder instead.

templates_dir.title: Templates folder
templates_dir.description: Folder of blank .docx templates new documents are created from. Read-only: templates can be opened and used as a starting point, never saved over, and it must be separate from the documents and output folders. Enter 'off' to run with no templates.

kb_dir.title: Knowledge-base folder
kb_dir.description: Every document opened, created or saved is also mirrored to Markdown here, which is what makes it searchable by the knowledge-base plugin. Keep it inside that plugin's documents folder (C:\Eva\knowledge) or the mirrors are never indexed. Enter 'off' to disable mirroring.

author.title: Tracked-change author
author.description: Optional. Name stamped on Word tracked changes, e.g. your own name.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Absolute path to the python.exe that has this server's pip dependencies installed (e.g. C:\Python311\python.exe). Use plain 'python' only if the right interpreter is first on PATH - a mismatch here is the most common cause of 'dependency missing' errors.
